metadata.description: Role-based plugins (subagents + technology skills) for software engineering teams.

plugins.name: frontend-role
plugins.description: Frontend Engineering & UI/UX role: builder and reviewer subagents plus React, Angular, Astro, styling, state, forms and a11y/perf skills.

plugins.name: qa-testing-role
plugins.description: QA, Test Automation & Quality role: qa-engineer and qa-reviewer subagents plus Vitest, Playwright E2E, playwright-cli, unit, API/integration, load, security/fuzz and test-strategy skills.

plugins.name: backend-role
plugins.description: Backend, APIs & Distributed Systems role: backend-builder and backend-reviewer subagents plus Node/TS, Python, Go, Java, .NET, Rust, SQL, Supabase, auth, queues, observability and architecture skills.

plugins.name: devops-infra-role
plugins.description: DevOps, Cloud & Platform Engineering role: devops-engineer and devops-reviewer subagents plus Docker, Supabase self-hosted, CI/CD, Terraform, Azure CLI and reverse proxy/Linux skills.

plugins.name: docs-architecture-role
plugins.description: Documentation & Software Architecture role: docs-architect and docs-reviewer subagents plus UKG knowledge graph and ADR/Mermaid diagram skills.
